title: When the Bridge Turns
author: Oscar Dunmore
blurb: Vesper Almeida, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, has spent three years learning which silences keep people safe. But when a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians before the ship sails on the morning tide.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
